name: Esreboxetine
summary: Esreboxetine (developmental code names AXS-14, PNU-165442G) is a selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor. It is the (S,S)-(+)-enantiomer of reboxetine and is even more selective as a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor in comparison. Esreboxetine was developed by Pfizer for the treatment of neuropathic pain and fibromyalgia.

pharmacology.text: Esreboxetine (developmental code names AXS-14, PNU-165442G) is a selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor. It is the (S,S)-(+)-enantiomer of reboxetine and is even more selective as a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor in comparison.

uses.text: Esreboxetine was developed by Pfizer for the treatment of neuropathic pain and fibromyalgia. It failed to show significant benefit over currently available medications and was discontinued.
